{{Quote|In order to fight against the Force, you must see what cannot be seen. Only four of you remain. Who will be the first to fall?|Asajj Ventress, to her Nightbrother candidates|<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>}}
[[File:TestOfNight-Monster.png|thumb|right|250px|The contestants of the Test of Night.]]
The '''Test of Night''' was the second in a series of trials that the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] and [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] were forced to pass to go on to become full warriors. Candidates fought much like they did in the [[Test of Fury/Legends|Test of Fury]], save for lacking the light of Dathomir's four [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Fighters sometimes employed the technique known as the [[Ears of the Chiroptix]] to pass the trial. Only [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Feral/Legends|Feral]] passed the Test of Night during [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].
